# Catherine Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P30](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0030)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

## Personality

Catherine Andrews maintains an optimistic outlook on life. She prefers to focus on the positive, noting that such a mindset is necessary given her living situation with [Eliza](../character/eliza-andrews.md).

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P21](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0021), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P31](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0031)_

## History

Catherine Andrews resided with her grim sister, Miss Eliza. While living together, Catherine maintained an optimistic demeanor despite her sister's opposing temperament. During a fundraising canvass for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village Improvement Society's hall painting project, the sisters were visited by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P0](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0000), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P12](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0012)_
